lines.text: Okay. The Mudville Possums owe you an apology.
We missed a few days of videos.
Big Lou got stuck in his helmet. Earl got lost driving to practice. And the cow ate the playbook.
But we're back, and we're catching up!
New days are coming fast. And every like is still a dollar for the team.
And thank you. Every like, every comment, every position request. You've given this team two thousand, seven hundred ninety dollars. You built this team!
We love you. Sorry. The Possums.
